faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: We answer the most common questions about our at-home services.
faq.q1: What types of massage do you offer in the comfort of my home?
faq.a1: We offer a variety of massages, including relaxing, therapeutic, sports and stress-relief massage, all done in the comfort of your home according to your needs.
faq.q2: How can I book an at-home massage?
faq.a2: You can easily book by calling us, sending us a message through our website or on WhatsApp, or through any of our social networks below. We are available to schedule your massage at the time that suits you best.
faq.q3: Do I need any special preparation before getting a massage at home?
faq.a3: You don't need to prepare in any special way, but we recommend being in a comfortable, relaxed setting. We bring everything needed for the massage; just make sure you have a quiet space.
faq.q4: How far do you travel to provide the at-home service?
faq.a4: We offer our services throughout the Monterrey metropolitan area. If you are not sure whether we cover your area, contact us and we will gladly confirm.
faq.q5: Is it safe to get a massage at home?
faq.a5: Yes. We are trained and follow strict standards of hygiene and professionalism. We make sure every service is safe, relaxing and good for your well-being.
